comparisons.reason: Different quantifiers and constructs. Left is an ANY over comments: 1 if at least one comment relies mainly on abstract normative (moral/rights/justice/value) principles, and an empty list gives 0. Right is an ALL over comments: 1 only if every comment is purely abstract or theoretical, with no specific verifiable procedural example. Right is not limited to normative principles, and it returns 0 if any comment gives such an example. Right returns null for an empty list, while left returns 0. Any versus all, different eligibility, and different empty-list handling make them distinct.
